title: Zkredit
tagline: Mina ZkApp for secure, private and bias-free mortgage credit
description: The project uses Mina to create a ZkApp that checks certain data points about a user such as their credit score and their average monthly income over the last two years to facilitate mortgage extensions without having to expose other data points, thus increasing personal privacy throughout the process.
how_its_made: By leveraging Mina, the project is able to operate through a smart contract (a ZkApp) that can check someones data by having them provide it through the CLI (in this case, the data is mocked). After the data is provided, it is checked agains the contract to guarantee that it comply's with the minimum requirements
